_readme: Fill ONLY from an approved source (e.g. Uganda Clinical Guidelines, MoH, WHO, or your facility's approved protocol). Do not invent doses or thresholds. Every entry is imported as a DRAFT and must be approved by an authorised person. category must be one of: general_assessment, common_illnesses, infectious, respiratory, gastrointestinal, paediatric, maternal, ncd, emergency, wound, laboratory, medication_safety, followup_referral. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD.
